text_en: Among trading products, those other than the following shall be classified into the trading account. (i) Non-listed stocks. (ii) Products planned to be underlying assets for securitization. (iii) Real estate held directly. (iv) Credit extended to individuals or medium and small-sized enterprises (meaning business corporations whose net sales (in cases where such business corporation prepares consolidated financial statements, consolidated net sales; the same applies hereinafter in this item) are less than 5 billion yen; provided, however, that in cases where such business corporation is engaged in wholesale trade or other cases where it is not appropriate to use net sales of such business corporation in judging the scale of its business, those whose total assets are less than 5 billion yen may be included). (v) Equity investments in funds (excluding those set forth in item (ii) of the following paragraph). (vi) Derivative transactions or funds for which any of the products set forth in the preceding items is an underlying asset. (vii) Products held for the purpose of hedging risks of products set forth in the preceding items.
